purpose: DISCOVERY CANDIDATES ONLY. Not approved training data until verified + license-audited.

candidates.name: XNLI
candidates.notes: 15 languages, 3-way NLI labels, professional human translation. Clean label target.

candidates.name: XQuAD
candidates.notes: 240 SQuAD paragraphs professionally translated into 10 languages. Cross-lingual benchmark.

candidates.name: MLQA
candidates.notes: 7 languages incl. Vietnamese. Answer spans annotated per language; benchmark => evaluation_only.

candidates.name: TyDi QA
candidates.notes: 11 typologically diverse languages. 'train' split training-eligible; 'validation' split is benchmark. Split by config.

candidates.name: FLORES-200
candidates.notes: 200-language translation benchmark. Recorded for coverage; translation-side tasks only.

candidates.name: FLORES+
candidates.notes: Community successor of FLORES with expanded low-resource language coverage.

candidates.name: MASSIVE (Amazon)
candidates.notes: 51 languages, 1M+ parallel utterances with intent/action labels. STRONG fit for WSTU state->action format.

candidates.name: XTREME
candidates.notes: Cross-lingual benchmark suite (40 langs, 9 tasks). Used as a discovery index into component tasks.

candidates.name: PAWS-X
candidates.notes: 7 languages, adversarial paraphrase ID, binary labels. Fits WSTU TRUE/FALSE outputs.

candidates.name: Samanantar
candidates.notes: Parallel corpora for 11 Indic languages, largely mined. Tag as mining-derived, not human-annotated.

candidates.name: IndicGLUE
candidates.notes: NLU suite for 11 Indic languages; multiclass label targets => high WSTU fit.
